checks.text: A woman skis along a snowy trail with a brown dog on a leash.
checks.notes: Skis, poles, leash and brown dog visible; corrected spelling only after visual check.
Both dresses and side-by-side people visible; walking is not certain from this frame. Consider stands next to and keep clothing-color relation.
Ski stunt and movie camera visible; precise handstand contact is ambiguous. Prefer skier performs an inverted stunt in front of a camera.
Fix gover typo. Dog and rocky ground visible; under the sky is a weak relation probe. Prefer dog moving between rocks if independently confirmed.
Three skydivers above the cloud layer visible; verify total and spatial relation against returned candidates.
Spotted dog on a porch mat visible; on top of the mat is a clearer relation target than rolling over alone.
Through the air is an action phrase, not a strong object-to-object relation. Visible bicycle is above skate-park ramps; use that relation after B checks.
Two children on pebble beach visible; source pairing supported. Check other beach images for additional relevance.
Two foreground hockey players compete near a ball; background people should not count as players in the target phrase.
Two paddlers visible in a canoe on a tree-lined river. Keep two-person count explicit.
Two seated children hold ice lollies; only one is visibly eating at the captured instant. Avoid claiming both mouths are eating.
Two golden dogs on wooden decking visible; add golden to color category if it is a target detail.
Man behind two pack animals visible; exact animal species is less certain. Consider two pack animals instead of asserting donkeys.
Three partial people on tabletop, cameras and drum visible; exact camera count could be ambiguous at thumbnail scale. Count people rather than cameras.
Green hat with pink flower pattern visible on skier; color claim supported.
Yellow shirt, surfboard and shoreline visible; supported.
Woman in green dress clearly visible. Standing is a pose, not necessarily dynamic action; make intended action taxonomy explicit.
Orange striped kitten touching person nose visible; bite/contact distinction needs larger-image check.
Dog has white, brown and dark fur; water spray visible. Shaking is plausible from source caption, but do not require fur to be only two colors.
Large blue and pink circles on glass doors visible; supported color cues.
People in life jackets in boat visible; smiling/laughing not equally clear for everyone. Keep riding and safety jackets.
Fix clack to black; curly dark dog visibly airborne along path.
Person and dog on beach visible; supported broad action query, likely requires checking extra beach images.
Child climbing rock visible; only the camera-operator shadow is visible. Filming claim should be checked with full resolution or omitted.
The numeral six is a racing bib, not a count of six dogs. Remove count category; retain action and yellow clothing color.
Woman holds child reaching for bubbles; grammar needs correction. Picnic setting is less explicit than outdoor bubbles.
